messages:
lucy ng: quick flag  canary unpack at partner site failed cosign verify on airgap bundle 3422222022 (installer + images). customer error: "cosign: verification failed: public key mismatch" :grimacing:

omar b: ack. which cosign key was used at packaging?

release-coordinator: packaging log shows signer id `key-2025-03-15` in the manifest. We rotated cosign key this morning to `key-2025-03-17` for KMS compliance.

lucy ng: copying relevant snippet from manifest: 
```
manifest:
  id: 3422222022
  artifacts:
    - images.tar.gz
    - installer-1.12.4.tar.gz
  signature_key: cosign:projects/redwood/key-2025-03-15
```

tara p: so packaging used the old key, deploybot attempted verify with new key -> mismatch. Did the packaging pipeline pick the wrong secret?

omar b: packaging reads /secrets/cosign.pub from the build agent. That agent missed the rotation push due to a transient gitlab runner outage.

devops-bot: [alert] signature-check-failed: manifest=3422222022 verify_status=FAILED verifier_key=key-2025-03-17 expected_key=key-2025-03-15

deploy-bot: [action] promotion-paused(manifest=3422222022) reason=signature_verification_failure

release-coordinator: options we discussed: 1) re-sign existing artifacts with the new key (no content change), 2) rebuild/repackage and publish a new bundle (new artifact tag), 3) have partner accept old signature (not acceptable for strict customers). Need to pick quickly for rollout window.

tara p: ops risk matrix: (1) fastest, low-content-risk, but we must make re-sign idempotent and log chain-of-custody. (2) safest audit trail but longer (repack + new checksums + courier re-escort). (3) only for non-regulated customers.

omar b: technical note: cosign re-sign won't change artifact hashes. We will produce a new signature blob. Customer verify step needs to trust current public key; if they pulled our public key from manifest pointer they'll be fine. If they pinned old key id explicitly they'll fail.

lucy ng: partner in this case uses our manifest pointer (not a pinned key) so re-sign should resolve. They are on a tight change window tonight; courier already loaded bundles.

release-coordinator: proposal: re-sign manifest with new key, push a delta signed manifest to mirror, and instruct courier to replace signature blob at unpack stage. Hold rollout for 30m while mirror syncs and partner verifies. If partner signals failure, fallback to republish tomorrow morning.

tara p: +1. Also add a short release note: "Resigned artifacts due to internal signer rotation; no content changes." Post to customers with verification steps.

omar b: I'll run the resign command and attach signed blob here. Command: 
```
./tools/cosign-resign \
  --manifest=manifests/3422222022.yaml \
  --key=/secrets/cosign.key \
  --out=signed/3422222022-resign.sig
```

devops-bot: [info] queued action: resign-manifest(3422222022) requested by omar b

ops-bot: [note] mirror sync required after new signature push. ETA 6-8 minutes for global mirrors.

omar b: resign complete. signed blob: https://mirror.internal/signed/3422222022-resign.sig sha256: d4b0c3a2f7c9a1e0b6f8c2d9e3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2

tara p: mirror shows new signature present on primary. Please confirm partner can fetch.

lucy ng: courier on-site confirms they replaced signature file during unpack. Partner ran cosign verify and returned: "OK".

deploy-bot: [info] verification-success(manifest=3422222022) rescind-pause and resuming promotion

release-coordinator: action items captured: 1) short customer note published, 2) patch packaging pipeline to re-fetch cosign pub on start, 3) create guardrail so runner failure blocks rotation commit.

ops-bot: [success] rollout completed for 3422222022 on all targets.

lucy ng: filing follow-up ticket INFRA-1299: packaging agent cosign sync + signer-rotation guardrails. Also adding a postmortem blurb for release notes.

tara p: add a check to the preflight that compares manifest.signature_key vs agent-published-key; fail build on mismatch.

omar b: noted, I'll add the preflight and a retry on runner fetch.

release-coordinator: thanks all. closing thread once INFRA-1299 is linked to the release notes.

ops-bot: [link] INFRA-1299: https://issues.internal/INFRA-1299

lucy ng: thanks team.
